label: Silencing the Signal: The Metastasis Suppressor NDRG1 Disrupts Small Extracellular Vesicle-Mediated Crosstalk in Pancreatic Cancer.
summary: Pancreatic cancer (PaC) remains one of the deadliest cancers, with 5-year survival rates of 13%. A major driver of its aggressiveness is the tumour microenvironment (TME), which fuels tumour growth, metastasis, and therapeutic resistance through dynamic, bi-directional communication between cancer cells, fibroblasts, and immune cells. Emerging evidence highlights extracellular vesicles (EVs) as key mediators of oncogenic cross-talk within the PaC TME. This study demonstrates for the first time…
